removeDialog.title: Delete route?
removeDialog.body: {{name}}'s CLI wrapper will be removed and its Desktop activation cleared. The route definition cannot be recovered without recreating it.

empty.intro: No routes yet. Add a route to run Claude Code or Claude Desktop against a non-Anthropic backend — Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, or any Anthropic-Messages-compatible gateway (Ollama, vLLM, OpenRouter, Kimi, DeepSeek, GLM, LiteLLM, …).
empty.wrappers: Each route installs a wrapper command on PATH — claude-llama3, claude-kimi, claude-bedrock-prod — and (optionally) a profile in Claude Desktop’s native configuration registry. The first-party claude binary and your Anthropic account are never touched.

addModal.title: Add a provider route
addModal.subtitle: Configure a non-Anthropic LLM backend. Picks the provider type below; per-provider fields appear inline.

editModal.title: Edit route
editModal.subtitle: Editing {{name}}. Secret fields are blank for safety — leave blank to keep the existing values, or type to replace.

card.useDesktopTitle: Mirror this route into Claude Desktop's enterpriseConfig
card.deleteTitle: Delete this route — also tears down its CLI wrapper and Desktop activation
